def mod_exp(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

class DSU:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.parent = list(range(n))
        self.size = [1] * n

    def find_parent(self, x):
        if self.parent[x] != x:
            self.parent[x] = self.find_parent(self.parent[x])
        return self.parent[x]

    def union_sets(self, a, b):
        a = self.find_parent(a)
        b = self.find_parent(b)
        if a != b:
            if self.size[a] < self.size[b]:
                a, b = b, a
            self.parent[b] = a
            self.size[a] += self.size[b]

def main():
    n, k = map(int, input().split())
    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    if k == 0:
        print(mod_exp(n, n - 1, MOD))
        return
    dsu = DSU(n)
    for i in range(n):
        dsu.union_sets(i, (i * k) % n)
    total = 1
    for i in range(n):
        if dsu.find_parent(i) != i:
            continue
        t = mod_exp(k, dsu.size[dsu.find_parent(i)], n)
        if t == 1:
            total = (total * n) % MOD
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
